translations.web: Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: And Jehoram rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David. And his son Ahaziah reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
